Name: Fishing Bubble Notifier
Author: BelLucifer
Description:
[b]Fishing Bubble Notifier[/b] is a simple SMAPI mod that periodically checks all reachable locations (like the Beach, Town, and Forest) for active fishing bubbles.
When new bubbles appear, it displays a small message such as:

[code]New Fish Bubbles found in Beach: South-East[/code]
Features:
[list]
[*]Scans all maps connected to your current location via warps.
[*]Avoids spam and performance issues by checking every 2 seconds.
[*]Works in both vanilla and modded maps with warp connections.
[*]Optional outdoor filter for better performance.
[/list]
Compatible with [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] and [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].[line]📦 Requirements[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0[/b] or later
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] or later
[/list][list=1]



[/list]🧩 Compatibility[list]
[*]Works in both Singleplayer and multiplayer (host only recommended).
[*]Compatible with most other mods.
[/list]
